first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a brown flat hat, a light blue long-sleeved top, gray-green bib overalls, and brown gloves; dark boots are visible later.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A goose with a white body, a long slender neck, an orange beak and legs and feet, and small black eyes.

entities.name: pond surface
entities.identification: A light blue water surface extending along the curved shoreline in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: pond-edge stones
entities.identification: A group of light gray irregular stones of varying sizes arranged along the boundary between the water surface and the lawn.

entities.name: aquatic plants
entities.identification: Clusters of pale green long leaves along the shore, dark green water-lily leaves on the water surface, and locally visible white flowers with yellow centers.

entities.name: small wooden bridge
entities.identification: A bridge structure partially extending in from image-left, with a brown wooden-plank surface and short supporting legs.

entities.name: gray-green lawn
entities.identification: A large expanse of gray-green ground outside the pond shore, with outlines of short grass along its edge.

entities.name: light gray path
entities.identification: A light gray road surface spanning the upper part of the image, with the edge on the lawn side curving gently.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: A brown wooden bench with vertical backrest slats, parallel seat boards, armrests, and legs.

entities.name: blue square object
entities.identification: A flat, nearly square object on the seat of the wooden bench, dark blue in the center and light blue along the edges.

entities.name: light gray handheld device
entities.identification: A light gray, flat, elongated rectangular device carried by Person A, with a dark component and a small red piece.
